notes.title: Patch 1.31 - Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who's provided feedback and the overwhelmingly positive response to our latest content update. Today we're launching a small patch to fix a bunch of the issues that were found and improve on some of the systems already in place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/0af0c81084c70d8957a7fa657f8dc2087d2bf707.jpg[/img]

We've made a lot of improvements to the bots in the game, including a way to disable them if you would like to play with only your friends. Bot pathing has been completely reworked so they will no longer get stuck if they get knocked off the path. 

Raptors also see some improvements that should level the playing field against those tasty humans. 

To disable bots on your dedicated server simply add the following code to the launch options:
[code]-NoBots[/code]
When hosting a p2p match simply untick Allow Bots when starting the match.

Below is a list of the changes/fixes that made it into this patch.

[h1]Additions:[/h1]
 - Added the ability to turn off bots in hosted games and on private servers
 - Added logic to bots so they can react to taking damage (provided they don't have a closer target already)
 - Added Raptor health regen

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
 - Made the vote counter larger if the map has any votes
 - Moved reload text up away from crosshair and made text smaller
 - Tightened Raptor sprinting turn radius
 - Increased Raptor attack radius 
 - Improved lighting in all Toybox maps
 - Improved lighting in all Off the Rails maps
 - Adjusted bot's run away mechanic. They will run away when health reaches less than 5 instead of less than 30

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
 - Fixed potential crash
 - Lowered spawn points on the plane in Picnic Panic to prevent getting stuck
 - Fixed incorrect win/loss screens on Toybox CTF
 - Fixed vote kick not showing the name of who was voted to kick
 - Fixed bots jittering when moving up/down slopes
 - Potentially fixed bots getting stuck in objects
 - Completely reworked bot pathing system so they will no longer just stop moving because they lost the navigation path

 - Fixed potential for Raptor to run in place when killed

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Bots, Maps, Sale and SO much MORE!
notes.notes:
You've all been waiting so patiently but it's finally here! The Mean Greens content update, and boy is it a good one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/f760732287b718e4c3c3997a4d6fe4771d9731d0.jpg[/img]

[h1]BOTS!!!![/h1]
The big news of course is that BOTS are finally available in The Mean Greens! Bots are automatically added to any team deathmatch or free for all map. During online play bots will autofill servers and leave as players join in. We're still tweaking the bots so please give us your feedback on how they're performing so we can continue to improve them.

[h1]New Maps[/h1]
In this update we've added new maps as well as new versions of old favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/68a239505c5eb91e74574ca8af9ce77684e4708d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Jurassic Plastic[/h2]
The first new map is called Jurassic Plastic. In this team deathmatch style map where a team of soldiers must fight against a team of toy raptors. At the end of the round the teams swap places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/d2f4f002053480dd8a06f11b0471088b4b329fff.jpg[/img]

[h2]Picnic Panic[/h2]
Drop in from the sky in this team deathmatch style map that takes place on a picnic table during an Independence Day celebration in the park. Beware though, bugs have invaded this picnic so you'll have to stay on your toes to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/d068325073df705d1cc44b3d587a7e94fbe51030.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map Gamemodes[/h2]
We've also created Team Deathmatch and Free For All versions of our current maps. Some of these maps are the same as the current versions, others are slightly altered and some are completely reworked for these game modes!

Toybox Assault even gets a capture the flag game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/b669404c334c25bcab8f123f4d4c66a985e0c342.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ranks & Leaderboards[/h1]
This update also sees our ranks and leaderboards implemented. Ranks are increased as players gain more and more experience, and are the perfect way to show everyone how skilled you are. Work your way up from Private all the way to Commander. Then check the leaderboards to see how you stack up against your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/67631d6b367a622c68c398ef8ae58d9fa3eb7fd4.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Characters[/h1]
5 new unique soldier characters have been added to the game and we've also added the ability to choose which character you spawn as in the new Customization menu.

[h1]Optimizations and Bug Fixes[/h1]
Throughout development we have been making massive improvements to the optimization of the game with some maps seeing significant frame rate improvement. Complete systems have been reworked to be more efficient and overall the game should run much smoother for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/d04f4459b8fa39e13b5f156e84176caeda83c68a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Major Sale![/h1]
To celebrate this massive update we're running another massive sale! From [b]March 16th 2020, 10am PST - March 20th 2020, 10am PST[/b] you can pick up The Mean Greens for only [b]$0.99![/b] That's right, we're doing another Dollar Sale! [b]This will be the LAST time we will be offering this ultra low price![/b] After this sale we will be raising the price of The Mean Greens to be more in line with the upcoming console release. So be sure to let all your friends know if they want to grab the game super cheap, now's the time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11088010/abab3af063a9c9f456318d182bd850e3c14e5d10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Consoles[/h1]
We are also happy to announce that we are currently in the certification process to bring The Mean Greens to Xbox One and PlayStation 4 (with Switch coming later on). It's been a long road but we are extremely happy to finally be bringing some plastic melting action to the living room. Stay tuned for more information as we get closer to release.

[b]Lets wrap up this post[/b]
A very special THANK YOU to everyone who's been active in our [url=https://discord.gg/zP4twkW]Discord server[/url] and to all of those who have joined our new [url=https://discord.gg/virtualbasement]Official Virtual Basement Discord Server[/url]. Thank you so much to everyone who's participated in the beta testing and helped out with the localization, hrider, GreatOldGame, ddanel, SampeyFS, Annoying Kumquat, Voeneg and Dirty Sanchez. 

Be sure to follow our [url=https://twitter.com/VirtualBasement]Official Virtual Basement Twitter Account[/url] to the latest news in all things Virtual Basement.

See you in the servers, lets melt some plastic!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11088010/51102ec7a2134b91cda320bd27b14c838141a02d.jpg[/img]

We are excited to be launching patch 1.18!

This patch brings with it a brand new map! Introducing Lazy Hamster, our new payload style level. Work with your team to get the hamster into its cage.

On top of the new map, patch 1.18 has a TON of bug fixes and improvements to help make The Mean Greens run as smooth as possible.

[h1]Steam Sale[/h1]

We are also proud to announce that we are taking part in Steam's Winter Sale and Mean Greens is at it's best price EVER! 75% off! That's right, you can now pick up Mean Greens for under $2.50!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/360940/The_Mean_Greens__Plastic_Warfare/

Below is a list of the changes/fixes that made it into this patch.

[h1]Additions:[/h1]
 - Added a new payload map “Lazy Hamster”

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[b]Kitchen Run[/b]
 - Made improvements to the User Interface trigger for winning when pushing the cup to 0 centimeters.
 - Fixed a bug where player would get stuck on the zipline when the cup is pushed near the end of the kitchen counter.

[b]Attic Attack[/b]
 - Made improvements to the Mouse control when flying.

[b]Sandbox Showdown[/b]
 - Balanced the threshold of boost for the vehicles Jeep and Buggy.

[b]Tutorial[/b]
 - Fixed a bug where if you lost the flag while dying in the tutorial it would not respawn.
 - Fixed collision issue bug with the bridge when traveling back with the flag.
 - Changed the letter of the text from “Press F to Enter Vehicle” to “Press E to Enter Vehicle” when near jeep.

[b]Options[/b]
 - Controller can now be selected in the options menu.
 - Controller buttons can now be bound to any user input selected.

[b]Voice Chat[/b]
 - Implemented team based voice chat.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
 - Fixed networking issue when traveling to a new gameplay session from an active gameplay session.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
 - Joining other games while in a game would fail to connect.
 - Fixed Green zipline repeating zip down when cup was close to edge
 - Fixed HUD for Kitchen run ruler + cup display accuracy
 - For tutorial map: added sound to pick up/drop flag, adjusted flag platform to prevent running into edge and stopping. 
 - Fixed controller rebinding menu not opening on pc click
 - Fixed Bathtub bash cheating by disabling collision on water
 - Fixed invisible flag issue on bathtub bash when killed while holding a flag
 - Fixed FOV on ultrawide monitors
 - Decreased time "Already Bound" message appears
 - Fixed set to default for sound tab for in-game Escape Option widget
 - Applied a fix for disconnecting controller leading to loss of control with keyboard and gamepad for PC
 - Fixed tutorial flag rolling sound bug
 - Fixed issue in Options -> Keybinding where player lost control of gamepad + arrow keys if attempting to change 'Disabled' controls

notes.title: Patch 1.17 - New Maps and Big Changes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11088010/0a9eee3a8e7829984d09335d45a1a25767601e0b.jpg[/img]

We are excited to launch patch 1.17, now with 20% more content [b]FREE[/b]!!!

That's right with this update we're launch 2 new maps, each with their own unique game mode. 

[h1]Attic Attack[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11088010/e989fcaf043751962b10240089c261b4600d946b.jpg[/img]
You'll be hitting the ceiling in no time with these enemy planes! Dodge and maneuver through this cluttered antique-filled attic. Once you get the barrel rolls and firing down, it should be plain sailing from there!

[h1]Sandbox Showdown[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11088010/9393aaf6a4ff4a979df5d85e23f8d588ef73dd99.jpg[/img]
Don't keep your head in the sand or your soldier will be saying good-bye in this sandbox showdown! Stay on the lookout, with each team having their own squad of vehicles, it becomes easier to travel across the map at faster speeds! So grab your ride or die and plan some sneak attacks!


Patch 1.17 is more than just a pretty new face, we've made all kinds of additions and improvements to the game!

[b]New Dynamic Server System[/b]
system built on But that's not all! This update also rolls out our new server the mighty Amazon server backbone. We have spent quite a bit of time developing this new dynamic server system to ensure that is both stable and fast. 

[b]New Tutorial Level[/b]
As an added bonus we created a tutorial level to help new players get their bearings before taking the fight online.

[b]So much more![/b]
In addition to all these awesome new features we have been hard at work crushing more bugs than a rampaging anteater! Way to many to list in this already long news post!

[h1]Steam Sale[/h1]

To celebrate the new maps, starting tomorrow The Mean Greens will be running a 50% off sale so there's never been a better time to pick up The Mean Greens, grab a few friends and jump online to prove once and for all which side is better, Green or Tan!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/360940/The_Mean_Greens__Plastic_Warfare/

Below is a list of the changes/fixes that made it into this patch.

[h1]Additions:[/h1]
 - Attic Attack level featuring aerial combat
 - Sandbox Showdown level with new vehicles
 - Tutorial level

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
 - New dynamic server system
 - Lighting improvements on every map
 - Added timer to Tabletop map
 - Changed how flamethrower detects a hit

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
 - So many bug fixes we lost track of them all! This patch is pretty much a RAID can
 - Improved performance on several levels
 - Fixed score calculation on Kitchen Run

notes.title: Patch 1.16 - Engine Upgrade, Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11088010/533ebd81f8c3cfd2bf3d8663dacb4455873fa0f2.jpg[/img]

[b]We just released our 1.16 patch for The Mean Greens. This patch features a lot of improvements and bug fixes![/b]

First and foremost we have upgraded our version of the Unreal Engine to 4.14. This brings with it a vast array of bug fixes and performance improvements. 

This patch also fixes all of the known issues that players have been experiencing, such as chat issues and scoreboard problems! The patch also fixes the issues we have been having with achievements not working properly, which I'm sure a lot of people will be very happy to hear. 

Below is a list of the changes/fixes that made it into this patch.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
 - Upgraded engine to version 4.14
 - Completely revamped animation system
 - New SFX and improved SFX triggers
 - Lowered lobby timers saving 20 seconds between games, for a faster experience
 - Improved Mac performance
 - Added support for OSX Sierra

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
 - [b]Fixed achievements[/b]! Tested and confirmed all of them are working proper
 - Added option to Sound Options menu to disable VOIP in game allowing Steam to take over mic
 - Fixed scoreboard issue when players would join mid match
 - Fixed potential issue that could cause lobby countdown to stick at 1
 - Fixed autoscroll on chat boxes!
 - Fixed respawn taking away control from the chat
 - Default key for chat somehow got reset to C, it is now fixed and back to [i]ENTER[/i] by default.
 - Fixed issue where some OK buttons could not be clicked but pressing ENTER would work, clicking now triggers the button
 - Added blocking volume behind bar doors in Barnyard Ball to prevent rare case where ball could get stuck behind them.
 - Fixed issue on Kitchen Run where players could fall into the countertop by the oven.

notes.title: 1.6 Update
notes.notes:
We just launched the 1.6 patch. Please restart Steam to make sure you get the patch. Thanks for playing.

[h1]Networking Changes:[/h1]

 - Added Mid Game Reservation System
 - Fixed a memory leak relating to reflection captures on servers
 - Fixed flamethrowers causing network lag and server crashes
 - Server browser, Join game and Invites will now request a reservation from a server before attempting to join. This will prevent server full dialogs and make sure the server is reachable by the client
 - Join game and Party system now favor player count instead of ping

 - Bazooka does more self damage but is instant kill on direct hit again
 - Chat default binding is now the enter key
 - Sniper headshot hitbox matches the shape of the characters more closely

 - Flamethrower damage lowered
 - All weapons except rocket launcher have 30 sec cooldown
 - Sniper Rifle is now 3/6 instead of 3/3 at spawn
 - M-16 slightly more accurate
 - Shotgun has slightly more spread

[h1]Achievements:[/h1]

 - Achievement backend system rewritten to prevent reset of achievement progress
 - Shark position is now replicated to clients to make it easier to get Ride the Shark achievement

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

 - Shotgun reload fixed when jumping on jello in Operation Birthday
 - Fixed candles appearing unlit for mid game joins in Operation Birthday
 - Fixed chat disapearing

[h1]Maps:[/h1]

 - Operation Birthday and Fishtank Frenzy stuck spots fixed
 - Prevent the ball from leaving the table on Branyard Ball
 - Removed invisible wall preventing projectiles by doughnuts on Kitchen Run

[h1]UI:[/h1]

 - Realighed UI elements in lobby screen
 - Controller/Keyboard Nav improved for server lobby
